svg.title: 1212 Lobdel Avenue — Four Corrected Fee-Simple Yield Options with Accurate Per-Lot Setbacks
svg.desc: Four site plans with corrected per-lot setbacks: Option B (36 units, 4 E-W rows, full independent setbacks), Option D (54 units, 6 E-W rows, shared drive easements), Option A corrected (18 units, 3 N-S rows, E-W orientation, full per-lot setbacks), Option C corrected (24 units, 3 N-S rows, shared N-S aisle easements).
svg.text: 1212 Lobdel Ave — Four Fee-Simple Yield Options (Corrected Per-Lot Setbacks)
Full per-lot setbacks · 4 E-W rows · units face N/S
Private front + rear yards · standard recorded lots
Shared drive easements · 6 E-W rows · units face N/S
Rear yard · 20 ft · 2.6 ft to N boundary
HOA easement docs · city rear yard confirmation req'd
E-W orientation · per-lot N-S setbacks · 3 N-S rows
Entry cross-drive from Lobdel Ave (20 ft) — runs E-W inside site
Was shown as 30 units — corrected: each lot needs
own 20ft front + 20ft rear → only 6 lots fit per N-S row
E-W orient. · shared N-S aisles as rear yards · 3 N-S rows
Entry cross-drive from Lobdel Ave (20 ft)
Shared aisle = rear yard easement (20 ft)
Was shown as 48 units — corrected: front=south(Lobdel),
8 lots max per row with shared N-S aisle easements
All four options — corrected fee-simple yields
B — N-S orient., full indep. setbacks
D — N-S orient., shared E-W easements (optimal)
Correction note: E-W orientation (Options A & C) yields were overstated in prior diagram.
In R-3, the front lot line is always the lot line nearest a public street. With Lobdel Ave only to the south, ALL lots
have their front on the south edge regardless of which way the building faces. Each lot must provide its own 20 ft
front setback (south) and 20 ft rear yard (north), reducing E-W yields to 6–8 lots per N-S row vs 10–16 as shown.
N-S orientation (Options B & D) is unaffected — setbacks already applied correctly along the N-S depth axis.
Parcel 2605130241 · 175 ft × 352.6 ft · 1.39 ac · R-3, Chapter 48, City of Wilmington
